snippet.title: SPOTSANITY - Taking a Stroll Through Thorn Garden!
snippet.description:
Thorn Garden is the first level in Spotsanity, and the only level that will be in the upcoming demo! Besides needing to polish somethings, the level is pretty much done!

Spotsanity is an upcoming fast-paced action-platformer about killing everything in your sight! You play as Spottie, a hunter struggling with his finances. When Spottie discovers many members of a notorious crime gang with massive bounties, he sets off to claim every single penny of those bounties. No matter what...

With a gameplay move set that mixes top-speeds and enemy combat, you'll explore unique levels that contain a variety of foes. It's up to you to take the cash-reward!

It's You VS. The World... Go Get Em!

What you see here is not the final product. Things are subject to change!
(Footage recorded by Sun on discord!)
